# Niuexa: AI Consulting, Process Automation and AI Visibility (AEO/GEO)

> Niuexa (NIUEXA S.R.L., VAT IT13489560014) is an AI consultancy for Italian SMEs,
> with its registered office in Turin (Via Vittorio Andreis 18) and an office in
> Milan (Via Rutilia 10). Started as a project in 2024 and incorporated as an S.r.l.
> in 2026, it is led by Gregor Maric (CEO, in business process automation since
> 2012) and Roberto Botto; it is controlled by Libera Brand Building Group and is
> a member of AUSED, the association of Italian CIOs.
> Niuexa works on three fronts: process automation with AI agents built on the
> systems a company already uses, visibility in AI assistants (AEO/GEO), and
> practical AI training.

## How Niuexa works
- "Prima misuriamo, poi automatizziamo": map and measure one process as it is (volumes, times, errors, exceptions), automate it on the existing systems, measure again, then decide with the client whether to extend, correct or stop
- "L'agente propone, la persona decide": exceptions and sensitive decisions go to a person, never straight into the ERP or CRM
- Niuexa says so when AI is not needed
- No published prices: a project's cost is set in a written quote after the analysis. The first 30-minute call is free
- No guarantees of savings, ROI or rankings; results are measured against a baseline agreed in writing
- Free worksheets usable without hiring Niuexa: [AI Metric Contract](https://niuexa.ai/ai-metric-contract.html), [AI Outcome Budget](https://niuexa.ai/ai-outcome-budget.html), [12 domande prima di firmare con un fornitore AI](https://niuexa.ai/articolo-due-diligence-fornitori-ai-pmi.html)

- [AI Agent – Come rendere efficienti i processi aziendali](https://niuexa.ai/eventi-ai-aziende/ai-agent-processi-aziendali/): 17 novembre 2026. Da quale processo conviene partire? Priorità, dati, permessi e indicatori per affidare a un agente AI un primo compito circoscritto e misurarne il valore.

Brief, contenuti per più canali, contatti da seguire: quali attività di marketing affidare a un agente AI mantenendo il controllo su messaggi, dati e approvazioni.

## Core Services

### AI Consulting and process automation
- [AI Consulting Services](https://niuexa.ai/consulting.html): Process analysis and measurement, use cases ranked by priority and feasibility, roadmap, and implementation on the client's existing systems
- [AI Consulting Services (English)](https://niuexa.ai/en/consulting.html): Shorter English services page (the Italian page adds the pre-order checks, vendor checks, KPI definition and budget sections)
- Typical clients: Italian SMEs with repetitive work in one office (administration, sales, marketing, technical and quality, management)
- Project length depends on scope, data quality, integrations and testing; it is set after the analysis, together with the work plan

### AI Products & Agents
- [AI Products](https://niuexa.ai/products.html): AI agents for sales, marketing and customer service, connected to CRM and management software
- [AI Products (English)](https://niuexa.ai/en/products.html): Products page in English
- Sales Agent: automation of steps in the sales funnel, with a person approving critical actions
- Marketing Agent: drafting content for several channels and supporting campaigns, with human approval of messages
- Voice Agent: AI phone agent for well-defined customer-service requests; languages, telephony and hours covered depend on the configuration and are tested on representative calls before go-live
- [ChatAziendale](https://niuexa.ai/chat-aziendale.html): No-code AI chatbot trained on your business documents and website. Answers grounded in your content, with sources cited; encrypted data. Free / €29 Pro / €149 Business. Live product at chataziendale.it
- [Keel](https://niuexa.ai/keel.html): MCP layer connecting Amazon Seller Central, Vendor Central, SP-API, Ads API and Brand Analytics to AI agents like Claude and ChatGPT. Multi-account, multi-marketplace natural-language queries. Live product at keelai.it

### AI Training Programs
- [AI Training](https://niuexa.ai/training.html): Practical AI training for teams and managers, in person or online
- [AI Training (English)](https://niuexa.ai/en/training.html): Training page in English
- Hands-on workshops with examples from the participants' own work

### AI visibility (AEO/GEO)
- [AEO/GEO consulting and free homepage audit](https://niuexa.ai/consulenza-aeo-geo.html): Free audit of the homepage's technical and editorial readiness for AI assistants, with fixes in order of impact. Whether ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity actually cite the company is a separate check of their answers, with documented questions, platforms and dates; it is not part of the free audit
- [AEO/GEO consulting (English)](https://niuexa.ai/en/ai-readiness-tool.html): English version of the audit page
- [AEO Analyzer Platform](https://aeo.niuexa.ai): Niuexa's tool for the AEO/GEO site audit (scores on five dimensions, corrections by priority); the Business plan adds a monthly audit of up to 25 agreed pages
- [AI Readiness Assessment](https://niuexa.ai/ai-readiness-assessment.html): Assessment of processes, data, skills and governance that ranks the AI use cases worth starting from

## Articles: AI Consulting & Business Strategy (Italian)
- [Consulenza AI in Italia: Come Scegliere il Partner Giusto](https://niuexa.ai/articolo-consulenza-ai-italia.html): Guide to choosing an AI consulting partner in Italy, comparing Big 4 firms, system integrators and boutique specialists

- [Il Management Chiede 'Mettiamo GenAI?': Framework Niuexa](https://niuexa.ai/articolo-management-genai-framework.html): Framework for responding to management requests for GenAI: value estimate, governance, triage
- [Rischi AI in Azienda: i 7 Rischi Principali](https://niuexa.ai/articolo-rischi-ai-azienda.html): The 7 key risks of AI adoption and Niuexa's Risk Canvas mitigation framework
- [Automazione Processi Manuali con AI](https://niuexa.ai/articolo-automazione-processi-manuali.html): When and how to automate manual processes: signals, first candidates, how to measure
- [Quanto costa automatizzare un processo con l'AI?](https://niuexa.ai/articolo-costi-automazione-guida.html): The 10 cost items of a quote for automating an office process with AI and agents, what moves the price, hidden costs and how to calculate payback on your own data
- [Prima il processo, poi l'AI agent](https://niuexa.ai/articolo-processo-prima-ai-agent.html): When an AI agent makes sense: map the process, data, KPIs, human control and adoption before choosing a tool or model
- [AI nei workflow operativi: dai pilot al valore misurabile](https://niuexa.ai/articolo-ai-workflow-operativi-enterprise.html): Framework to map processes, data, roles, governance and training before scaling automations and AI agents
- [Strategia AI aziendale: la roadmap dai processi](https://niuexa.ai/ai-consulting/strategia-ai-aziendale.html): How to build an AI strategy: assess data and processes, rank use cases, plan roadmap, governance, budget and metrics
- [Esempi di AI per settore: 12 scenari illustrativi](https://niuexa.ai/ai-consulting/casi-studio-ai.html): 12 illustrative (not real) scenarios by sector with the typical problem, the solution and what to measure before and after
- [Niuexa entra in AUSED](https://niuexa.ai/articolo-aused-partnership.html): Why Niuexa joined AUSED, the association of Italian CIOs active since 1976
- [Dal PoC alla produzione](https://niuexa.ai/articolo-poc-produzione.html): How to move an AI project from proof-of-concept to production, in four phases with go/no-go criteria agreed up front
- [Tool e Practice per Creare Agenti AI](https://niuexa.ai/articolo-tool-agenti-ai.html): Tools and practices for building reliable AI agents, in a 10-step workflow

## Articles: AI governance and operations for SMEs (Italian)
- [Human-in-the-Loop per PMI](https://niuexa.ai/articolo-human-in-the-loop-ai-pmi.html): Decision matrix, escalation thresholds, roles and KPIs for human control of AI workflows and agents
- [Due diligence fornitori AI: 12 domande](https://niuexa.ai/articolo-due-diligence-fornitori-ai-pmi.html): Checklist to evaluate an AI vendor before signing: data, quality, security, costs, continuity, AI Act, exit clauses
- [Contratto di qualità per workflow AI](https://niuexa.ai/articolo-contratto-qualita-workflow-ai.html): Defining inputs, outputs, controls and acceptance criteria for a reliable AI workflow
- [Change management AI per PMI](https://niuexa.ai/articolo-change-management-ai-pmi.html): Classify, test, approve and monitor changes to models, prompts, data and workflows
- [Incident response AI per PMI](https://niuexa.ai/articolo-incident-response-ai-pmi.html): Runbook for AI incidents: severity, containment, evidence, recovery, communication, post-mortem
- [Inventario AI per PMI](https://niuexa.ai/articolo-inventario-ai-pmi.html): Building an inventory of AI uses: find shadow AI, assign owners, classify risks, govern workflows
- [Fonte unica per assistenti AI](https://niuexa.ai/articolo-fonte-unica-assistenti-ai.html): Documents, owners, deadlines and permissions for reliable AI assistants and RAG systems, with a 30-day plan
- [Memoria degli AI agent: framework 4D](https://niuexa.ai/articolo-memoria-ai-agent-framework-4d.html): Classify what an agent remembers by data, use, duration and review rights
- [Coda di lavoro per AI agent: framework 4C](https://niuexa.ai/articolo-coda-lavoro-ai-agent.html): Taking an agent to production: queue, capacity, continuity and verifiable delivery
- [Process mining per PMI](https://niuexa.ai/articolo-process-mining-ai-pmi.html): Reconstruct the real flow, find variants and bottlenecks, choose where to apply AI
- [Reporting AI: dal report al decision brief](https://niuexa.ai/articolo-reporting-ai-decision-brief.html): Automating reporting with authorised sources, consistent KPIs, controls, exceptions and a measurable pilot
